headline: US Voters Head to Polls for Midterm Elections Amid Control Battles
summary: American voters head to the polls to elect all 435 seats in the House of Representatives and 35 Senate seats, with Democrats poised to challenge Republican majorities.
why: US congressional elections determine legislative control, which directly influences fiscal policy, regulatory agendas, and federal spending priorities.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: National legislative elections alter political control and future policy direction.
